sections.title: Description
sections.content: End-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platform that analyzes cybersecurity threats by combining semantic search with local large language models to generate contextual threat intelligence reports and mitigation recommendations.

sections.title: Challenge
sections.content: Design a scalable AI system capable of retrieving accurate cybersecurity knowledge from multiple threat intelligence sources while minimizing hallucinations and generating context-aware threat analysis.

sections.title: Solution
sections.content: Built a modular RAG pipeline using LangChain for document ingestion, Hugging Face embeddings, ChromaDB for semantic retrieval, Ollama-hosted Llama 3.2 for local inference, and a FastAPI backend for AI-powered threat intelligence generation.

sections.title: Impact
sections.content: Built a production-style AI architecture demonstrating vector search, retrieval-augmented generation, local LLM inference, and REST API integration for contextual cybersecurity analysis.

sections.title: Description
sections.content: Production-ready cloud data pipeline built using AWS, Terraform, Docker, and Python following the Medallion Architecture.

sections.title: Challenge
sections.content: Design a scalable end-to-end data engineering pipeline capable of ingesting, validating, transforming, and serving analytics-ready datasets.

sections.title: Solution
sections.content: Implemented a Bronze-Silver-Gold architecture with modular ETL workflows, infrastructure as code using Terraform, Docker-based execution, and automated validation.

sections.title: Impact
sections.content: Demonstrates production-ready data engineering practices including reproducible infrastructure, scalable processing, and analytics-ready outputs.

sections.title: Description
sections.content: End-to-end software vulnerability detection pipeline that reconstructs function-level datasets from real-world GitHub repositories and compares traditional machine learning models with a fine-tuned CodeBERT transformer.

sections.title: Challenge
sections.content: Develop an automated vulnerability detection system capable of extracting vulnerable and patched C/C++ functions from real-world repositories while preventing information leakage.

sections.title: Solution
sections.content: Built a complete dataset extraction pipeline with repository mining, patch analysis, function extraction, duplicate removal, and CVE-aware evaluation. Compared TF-IDF baselines with a fine-tuned Microsoft CodeBERT model.

sections.title: Impact
sections.content: Generated a dataset of 6,334 function-level samples from 3,805 processed CVEs. CodeBERT achieved the highest Recall (98.38%) and F1-score (63.24%).

sections.title: Description
sections.content: Machine learning project that forecasts weekly product demand from over one million retail transactions using XGBoost and advanced feature engineering.

sections.title: Challenge
sections.content: Forecast weekly demand accurately using historical retail transaction data while capturing seasonality and temporal trends.

sections.title: Solution
sections.content: Built an end-to-end forecasting pipeline with extensive data cleaning, lag features, rolling averages, and an XGBoost Regressor deployed as a Streamlit application.

sections.title: Impact
sections.content: Reduced forecasting error to 20% MAPE on real-world retail data while accurately capturing seasonal demand trends.

sections.title: Description
sections.content: Sentiment analysis application comparing a rule-based TextBlob baseline with a Twitter-trained RoBERTa transformer model.

sections.title: Challenge
sections.content: Compare traditional sentiment analysis techniques with transformer-based NLP models.

sections.title: Solution
sections.content: Built a Streamlit application integrating TextBlob and a pretrained Twitter RoBERTa model for real-time tweet sentiment classification.

sections.title: Impact
sections.content: Demonstrated the benefits of transformer-based NLP for social media sentiment analysis.
